Diagnostician / vehicle diagnostician: in Zurich, November 1st, 2026 or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. More about the job as a diagnostician: at the SBB and this link. You can find our other benefits such as child allowances, free 2nd class GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits. You can move that. - As a vehicle diagnostician, you will use modern diagnostic equipment to precisely diagnose faults on passenger transport rolling stock. - You enjoy diagnosing faults during operation and during downtimes. - You are actively involved in projects that increase the availability of our trains and minimize disruption times. - In addition, you are happy to take on site-specific tasks and help shape the operations on site. This is what you bring with you. - You are characterized by analytical skills, quick comprehension and networked thinking and enjoy making independent decisions. To promote your professional development, you are prepared to complete targeted training. - Very good knowledge of spoken and written German (C1) rounds off your profile. Knowledge of a second national language is an advantage. Your good IT skills help you write reports every day and document your work completely. - You are open to night and shift work and have a driving license Cat. ## Your salary and your benefits.
